title: llm-usage-metrics configuration
description: User configuration for llm-usage-metrics. Command-line flags override environment variables, environment variables override this file, and this file overrides built-in defaults.

timezone.description: Default IANA timezone for report bucketing; maps to --timezone.

logLevel.description: Stderr logging level; --quiet overrides this to warn for one command.

sources.description: Default source filter; maps to repeatable --source values.

items.description: Source id to include by default.

sourceDirs.description: Default source path overrides; maps to --<source>-dir, --<source>-db, or --source-dir.

pi.description: Default path for Pi sessions; maps to --pi-dir. A list scans several directories.

codex.description: Default path for Codex sessions; maps to --codex-dir. A list scans several directories.

copilot.description: Default path for GitHub Copilot telemetry; maps to --copilot-dir. A list scans several directories.

gemini.description: Default path for Gemini CLI data; maps to --gemini-dir. A list scans several directories.

droid.description: Default path for Droid sessions; maps to --droid-dir. A list scans several directories.

claude.description: Default path for Claude projects; maps to --claude-dir. A list scans several directories.

openclaw.description: Default path for OpenClaw agents; maps to --openclaw-dir. A list scans several directories.

opencode.description: Default OpenCode SQLite database path; maps to --opencode-db.

goose.description: Default Goose SQLite database path; maps to --goose-db.

amp.description: Default path for Amp threads; maps to --amp-dir. A list scans several directories.

qwen.description: Default path for Qwen projects; maps to --qwen-dir. A list scans several directories.

kimi.description: Default path for Kimi sessions; maps to --kimi-dir. A list scans several directories.

cline.description: Default path for Cline tasks; maps to --cline-dir. A list scans several directories.

roocode.description: Default path for RooCode tasks; maps to --roocode-dir. A list scans several directories.

kilocode.description: Default path for KiloCode tasks; maps to --kilocode-dir. A list scans several directories.

antigravity.description: Default path for Antigravity conversations; maps to --antigravity-dir. A list scans several directories.

dsh.description: Default path for DeepSeek Harness sessions; maps to --dsh-dir. A list scans several directories.

offline.description: Use cached LiteLLM pricing by default; maps to --pricing-offline.

url.description: Default LiteLLM pricing source URL; maps to --pricing-url.

overridesPath.description: Default JSON pricing overrides path; maps to --pricing-overrides.

ignoreFailures.description: Continue without estimated costs when pricing cannot be loaded; maps to --ignore-pricing-failures.

cacheTtlMs.description: Pricing cache TTL in milliseconds; clamps to 60000..2592000000.

fetchTimeoutMs.description: Pricing fetch timeout in milliseconds; clamps to 200..30000.

enabled.description: Enable the SQLite event store; maps to LLM_USAGE_EVENT_STORE.

path.description: SQLite event-store file path; maps to LLM_USAGE_EVENT_STORE_PATH.

parseMaxParallel.description: Maximum parallel file parsing; clamps to 1..64.

parseWorkers.description: Worker-thread parser count for registered large JSONL sources; maps to LLM_USAGE_PARSE_WORKERS. Use "auto" to resolve from available CPU parallelism; integer values clamp to 0..64, where 0 disables workers.

parseWorkerMinBytes.description: Minimum total bytes of event-store misses before worker-thread parsing engages; maps to LLM_USAGE_PARSE_WORKER_MIN_BYTES and clamps to 0..9007199254740991.

skipCheck.description: Skip the startup update check; maps to LLM_USAGE_SKIP_UPDATE_CHECK.

cacheTtlMs.description: Update-check cache TTL in milliseconds; clamps to 0..2592000000.

fetchTimeoutMs.description: Update-check fetch timeout in milliseconds; clamps to 200..30000.

directoryPaths.description: One directory path, or a list of directories to scan.
